messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (duplicate) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is the core problem still open, not solved by a shipped story and not covered by a roadmap item? Pass means yes.
Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.
The evidence is the problem statement and the five most similar stories and roadmap pages, with status and dates.
</definition>

 "problem_statement": "Users are unsure how to adjust reserves after a claim is approved, leading to delays and inaccurate financial tracking. This creates uncertainty in claim management and risks misstated liabilities.",

  },
  {

   "id": "4128",

   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": true, \"completed_at\": \"2026-09-15T00:00:00Z\", \"description\": \"Keelwater now allows users to filter claims by date range, status, and claim type, making it easier to locate specific claims without scrolling through unrelated entries.\", \"id\": 4128, \"name\": \"Claim search refinements\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 3}"
  },
  {

   "id": "4132",

   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": true, \"completed_at\": \"2026-09-15T00:00:00Z\", \"description\": \"Keelwater now displays a chronological activity timeline for each claim, showing key events, user actions, and system updates in a clear, scrollable interface to improve case tracking and accountability.\", \"id\": 4132, \"name\": \"Activity timeline display\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 3}"

  }
 ]
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the problem statement about adjusting reserves after claim approval against the five similar items. None of the similar stories or roadmap pages address reserve adjustment or post-approval reserve management: they cover a supplier directory, bulk document upload, claim search refinements, activity timeline, and claim information display, all with low similarity (≤0.052). No completed story solves the same problem, and no roadmap item covers it; the closest items are unrelated features despite being shipped.", "verdict": "pass"}
